name: Selam Restaurant
whatItIs: Family-run Ethiopian and Eritrean restaurant that began as a coffee shop in 2007; name means "peace" in Amharic; offers coffee ceremony.
evidence: Own site lists the Minnehaha Avenue address with online ordering; From MPLS With Love guide, last updated October 2026, describes it as operating.

name: Meseret Ethiopian Restaurant
whatItIs: Family-owned Ethiopian restaurant with a Sunday vegan and vegetarian buffet and coffee served with incense.
evidence: Listed as operating in From MPLS With Love guide, last updated October 2026.

name: Katar River Restaurant & Bakery
whatItIs: Restaurant and bakery known for injera sold to take home.
evidence: Guide updated October 2026 describes it as open daily.

name: Shabelle Ethiopian Grocery & Restaurant
whatItIs: Grocery and restaurant selling teff flour, spices, green coffee, jebena pots and injera.
evidence: Guide updated October 2026 describes current grocery and restaurant service.

name: The Red Sea
whatItIs: Ethiopian and Eritrean restaurant open since 1990, with a bar, dance floor and weekend live music.
evidence: Guide updated October 2026 describes it as operating.

name: Dilla's Ethiopian Restaurant
whatItIs: Ethiopian restaurant with a lunch buffet.
evidence: Guide updated October 2026 says it is open seven days a week.

name: Lulu Ethiovegan
whatItIs: Plant-based Ethiopian restaurant by Chef Tigist Feyisa, using pure teff injera.
evidence: Guide updated October 2026 describes it as operating.

name: Bolé Ethiopian Cuisine (Como)

whatItIs: Restaurant named for the Addis Ababa neighborhood where co-owners Solomon Haile and Rekik Abaineh grew up.
evidence: Own site lists the Pascal Street location with online ordering; Visit Saint Paul guide (2026) lists it.

name: Bolé (Maple Grove)
evidence: Own site lists a Maple Grove location with an ordering link.

name: Erta Ale Ethiopian Restaurant
whatItIs: Restaurant that also sells hard-to-find ingredients; open late on weekends.
evidence: Visit Saint Paul listing (site copyright 2026) shows current weekly hours.

name: ZeHabesha
neighborhoodOrCity: St. Paul (studio off Snelling Ave., per Sahan Journal, 2020)
whatItIs: Ethiopian news outlet founded in Minnesota in 2008 by Henok A. Degfu; began as a monthly newspaper in English and Amharic; now online and video.

name: Adey Abeba General Import and Ethiopian Store
whatItIs: Rochester's first Ethiopian store, opened summer 2024 by Kebede Abay of Eagan; injera, teff, coffee, clothing, cosmetics.
evidence: Only source is an August 2024 Post Bulletin article; no 2025 or 2026 sign of operation found.

name: AMA Law Group, PLLC
whatItIs: Immigration, family, criminal, personal injury and Social Security disability practice; principal attorney Abdinasir Abdulahi speaks English, Somali and Amharic; staff speak Amharic and Somali.
evidence: Own site lists address and phone, but its most recent dated posts are from 2024.

name: Merkato African and American Grocery
whatItIs: Grocery run by Enuye Faneta, profiled by MPR News in 1999, selling teff flour and injera to Ethiopian, Eritrean, Oromo and Somali customers.
evidence: Only source is a 1999 MPR News story; current status unknown.

name: Asnake Seble (adult foster care)
whatItIs: Adult foster care business owned by Seble Asnake, named by Sahan Journal in 2020.
evidence: Only source is a July 2020 Sahan Journal article.
